title: Finally
content: After years of using Evernote for diary entries, which was great, but not really fit for purpose, I thought to myself, I want something really simple. Maybe I could pay a developer to make it for me? But first look around, right? It wasn’t immediately obvious Day One was a fit from the external reviews, there are a lot of diary apps out there that aren’t meant for writers, or people who are already serious about keeping a journal. But I’ve only been in it a few days and you’d have to screw up to lose me. The platform is great for creating (I haven’t got into syncing or password issues yet). The thing I was really looking for was something that pointed me back to posts from years past, talking about the same subjects, etc, as a reminder and a pointer to what is more meaningful over time. And it was there. (I’d like a subject matter reminder as well, hopefully some AI will help out on that in the future.) I think my favourite feature though is the photos, my photo feed is probably a more meaningful diary than the words I remember to write. Now I can not only capture my thoughts at the end of the day but put context around the images from the day as well, which in turn generate new and often betting thinking. The only issue now is transferring over many hundreds of Evernote diary entries, which is fine and easy enough to do, one-by-one. As I do them the old photos from the stream pop up and I want to add some words to contextualise them - but when I tap the pics they don’t go to the day, they come back to the present and you have to scroll back through a year or more of pics to find the one you were looking for. So developers, small thing I know, but I suspect those serious diarists who are new to Day One will appreciate a quick look at this.
author: Auskearney

title: Pretty much only limited by your imagination
content:
I tried this app out as a digital bullet journal alternative, and boy can I say, I’ve only had it for just under a week and I will be definitely keeping my premium status after the trial (though I changed it from yearly to monthly). I love that you can make different journals for different things, a few I have are: planner (to do lists and stuff), habits, dream journal and a budgeting section. 

I will say I was a bit confused at first, but you really just need to dive in and try things out. This app is exactly what I wanted and more, I think the one thing that would make it better would be a calendar planner section where you can add appointments and things ahead of time, without it clogging up the top of the main journal page you put it in, but it would only show up a set amount of time in advance (you could set it to a few days, a week, a month). 

I highly recommend this app to anyone looking for a good diary, notebook, to-do list, planner, or digital bullet journal.
author: Direwolf Brenda

title: Amazing!

author: gordowhosaid1

title: Amazing Journal(s)
content:
I’ve been using Day One for a few years now, and I’ve varied my use of it overtime from something I needed to confide in, to a recordkeeping tool, regular journal, basically whatever I needed. The best part about it is for all my different needs, you can just create a different journal and have all these different journals accessible within the app. 

It is easy to go back and find older entries or specific events or mentions or things using the search function. You can also custom tag entries which is handy. I also like that it has a “on this day” feature that will show you entries from this day from previous years. 

Sometimes I type my entries out, and sometimes I dictate my entries and go back and fix them up real quick with the keyboard, but you can also put in video entries, which I don’t do much, but I do upload a lot of photos. You can also have your entries printed out over whatever time range you want if you would like hardcopies as well. 

It’s only slightly higher priced than a hardcopy journal, and yet it comes with so, so, so many more features. It syncs across all my devices and I use it all the time, any time, anywhere. I highly recommend this journal.

content:

I tried all the steps in your help articles to retrieve the missing data, and when that didn’t work I contacted your support, as advised in your help articles.

I was extremely disappointed when your help technicians repeatedly referred me back to the support articles I had already read and suggested methods I had already tried.

It seems the data that went missing has simply disappeared (over 350 entries) and the help technicians can’t explain why or offer an apology.

I trusted your app to store my data, but now doubt the reliability of your service and I’m extremely worried that other journals may go missing in the future when your app crashes again.

Thank-you Day One! ♥

content:
Not sure why they’ve changed the share options so that you have to choose export now. Annoying when developers change things that are working got no reason. Also it could backup to iCloud for nothing but instead they try to charge for their own cloud backup. Silly.

author: Jazeboy

title: Efficient, multi-purpose and user friendly!
content: I’ve been using day one only for a few days and I’m really enjoying the interface, the friendless and the ease of writing daily journals. It offers many things that help enhance your journal entries from the traditional aspect that allows you to add photos, add audio and many more other things that help capture your day. Another really great implementation is the daily quotes or phrase you’re given each day. Couldn’t recommend anything else!
author: Tommyjtruong

title: The perfect journaling app
content: DayOne is ideal for journaling. Some people have said to me, “Oh, I just use Evernote for that.” To me, that’s like doing your journal in your scrapbook, mixed in with other miscellaneous clippings. Your journal is important enough to warrant its own ‘place’ and app, and DayOne is the best app in this category. It has a beautiful interface, is intuitive to use, syncs between my iPhone, iPad and MacBook Pro (and to the cloud) and adds value to my entries with things like tagging my location for each entry. Highly recommended.
author: getmc

title: Easy to record your memories
content:
It’s simple to use with flexibility to do what you need. I like the way it allows you to upload photos against each entry and I’m just starting to get used to the email in functionality.

If you want to start recording your experiences and feelings. This is definitely the way to do it. If have a manual diary this is a great way to transfer to digital for ease of entry and retrieval.

Well done to this company!
author: Red4567ph

content: As per your website, “Believe your eyes, it’s happening. author: Tricky Trimble

title: Day One anchors my day
content: I have been using this app for 8 years now. Beside it being reliable and able to sync to my other devices without any problems. It has become a staple app for my life. I use it every day. Being able to record pictures, places as well as my inner thoughts is a powerful spiritual tool. Each day being able to track and remember where I was at the same date years earlier.
author: Rodrockir101

title: Love it...but lost it when I upgraded to newest version.
content: Love this app and used it for a year or so now to collect and organise my notes and extensive research links. Unfortunately I’ve lost all but one dairy when I upgraded to the new version last week. NOT HAPPY. Makes me think twice now to continue to use the app. Was thinking of purchasing the year subscription but have definitely shied away from that idea now. 😕 👎🏻
author: alseas1

title: Finally
content: After years of using Evernote for diary entries, which was great, but not really fit for purpose, I thought to myself, I want something really simple. Maybe I could pay a developer to make it for me? But first look around, right? It wasn’t immediately obvious Day One was a fit from the external reviews, there are a lot of diary apps out there that aren’t meant for writers, or people who are already serious about keeping a journal. But I’ve only been in it a few days and you’d have to screw up to lose me. The platform is great for creating (I haven’t got into syncing or password issues yet). The thing I was really looking for was something that pointed me back to posts from years past, talking about the same subjects, etc, as a reminder and a pointer to what is more meaningful over time. And it was there. (I’d like a subject matter reminder as well, hopefully some AI will help out on that in the future.) I think my favourite feature though is the photos, my photo feed is probably a more meaningful diary than the words I remember to write. Now I can not only capture my thoughts at the end of the day but put context around the images from the day as well, which in turn generate new and often betting thinking. The only issue now is transferring over many hundreds of Evernote diary entries, which is fine and easy enough to do, one-by-one. As I do them the old photos from the stream pop up and I want to add some words to contextualise them - but when I tap the pics they don’t go to the day, they come back to the present and you have to scroll back through a year or more of pics to find the one you were looking for. So developers, small thing I know, but I suspect those serious diarists who are new to Day One will appreciate a quick look at this.
author: Auskearney

title: Pretty much only limited by your imagination
content:
I tried this app out as a digital bullet journal alternative, and boy can I say, I’ve only had it for just under a week and I will be definitely keeping my premium status after the trial (though I changed it from yearly to monthly). I love that you can make different journals for different things, a few I have are: planner (to do lists and stuff), habits, dream journal and a budgeting section. 

I will say I was a bit confused at first, but you really just need to dive in and try things out. This app is exactly what I wanted and more, I think the one thing that would make it better would be a calendar planner section where you can add appointments and things ahead of time, without it clogging up the top of the main journal page you put it in, but it would only show up a set amount of time in advance (you could set it to a few days, a week, a month). 

I highly recommend this app to anyone looking for a good diary, notebook, to-do list, planner, or digital bullet journal.
author: Direwolf Brenda

title: Amazing!
content: After my father recently passing away from cancer. I had become depressed, resentful to my family and enter a dark place. It has been 5 months and I was watching a self help documentary. In this doco they recommended journaling everyday to help with my emotions. So I searched through loads of apps. I read current user reviews and thought to myself why not, this one sounds great. I’m not one to pay for apps but this was worth every scent. I have used this app for 4 consecutive days now. I know short, but I have created multiple entries. You can create more then one ‘journal’ at a time. I’m currently journal about ‘my life at 30’ and new business ideas for a project I’m working on. You can also create books from this app. How amazing, it’s absolutely changed my life and my vision to life. I can now express myself in words in total secret or I can chose to share through social media. Hope you enjoy and support this amazing app as much as me. I would love to see what else they can add in the near future. 5 stars!!!
author: Megz@87

title: The journal I have never read….
content: I have never re read anything I have written!! Like when I was younger I never wanted to know anything I did or didn’t do the night before.. But with this online journal it will often ask you if you want to relive what you were doing on some random day/night and that actually appeals to me, I feel like a fly on the wall of a stranger’s house,!!, not as some kind of voyeur but it just puts a wall between knowing and not knowing what or when the writing was done and it is always kinda weird reading words I don’t remember writing, and that appeals to me. Give it a go, if a disconnect hermit like me can enjoy it, I am sure there are plenty of outsiders out there who could do with an app like this, if only to write your mad ideas and theories in !!
author: SimonSkipRussell-AUS…

title: Amazing app - pity I can’t access ANY of my past entries
content:
I used this app for photo, video and written diary entries. It’s awesome to use and fitted my needs perfectly. However, when I changed phones, none of my video or photo data was accessible. Not one. Now I’ve lost around 6 months’ worth of detailed entries. Thanks a million Day One. 

Don’t use this app if you want to actually access this data in the future. What a waste of time.

title: day one
content: I liked this app - what i don't like is paying for the premium application as a yearly subscription, and the frigging sync deciding it isn't going to keep syncing, maybe because someone plays funny buggers with my apple accounts...either way, I'm less impressed now than I was initially. author: gordowhosaid1

title: Amazing Journal(s)
content:
I’ve been using Day One for a few years now, and I’ve varied my use of it overtime from something I needed to confide in, to a recordkeeping tool, regular journal, basically whatever I needed. The best part about it is for all my different needs, you can just create a different journal and have all these different journals accessible within the app. 

It is easy to go back and find older entries or specific events or mentions or things using the search function. You can also custom tag entries which is handy. I also like that it has a “on this day” feature that will show you entries from this day from previous years. 

Sometimes I type my entries out, and sometimes I dictate my entries and go back and fix them up real quick with the keyboard, but you can also put in video entries, which I don’t do much, but I do upload a lot of photos. You can also have your entries printed out over whatever time range you want if you would like hardcopies as well. 

It’s only slightly higher priced than a hardcopy journal, and yet it comes with so, so, so many more features. It syncs across all my devices and I use it all the time, any time, anywhere. I highly recommend this journal.
author: Jack Spazzow

title: Enjoyable
content: After more than 600 days using the platform, I gotta say it is pretty enjoyable. You can track absolutely anything - from what day, to the place, to the weather, and many more. The only reason I didn’t give 5 stars was because of 2 main reasons - and those were because there hasn’t really been a major update (I would say add something like being able to create art diaries, or to be able to add a ‘mood meter’ for every diary day you make. The other reason is I think with so many other features, the ‘Basic’ version of the app should be with more features. Yes, I know you will need to make money no matter what - but with the amount of features, you might wanna add a few more features to the basic version. But overall, pretty enjoyable!
author: aussie-person

title: Day One has changed my life
content: I wanted a journal to keep a record of my life but Day One is so much more. I started with the free version but when I learned about all the great features of the paid edition I switched and I’m so glad I did. I’ve been using the premium edition for over 3 years. I love the voice memo and I upload videos and photographs to my entries that take journaling to another level. I love the unlimited journals on premium and I have quite a few as I have many interests. I use Day One in my business to provide an information PDF which I export to my clients on Signal and it’s just fantastic how well both apps work together. I tell people to get Day One and transform their lives. It’s has for me! PS. A BIG thank you 🙏 to the developers and a kiss from me 😘
author: Ms Alleyne

title: Day one
content:
This is the best diary application that I have come across. It is very functional and has lots of features. so far as I know it doesn’t work on Windows machines, but it really is perfect on iPhone and iPad. It’s very responsive and quite easy to navigate.
The biggest problem that I find with it is not a criticism of the application it Millia criticism of me, forgetting to put in an entry on each particular day and sometimes I’ll go for a week or more without remembering to do anything on the app.
It is sometimes quite convenient to look at photographs in the photograph album for given dates and they can act as an aide memoire regarding past events and they can be added to the calendar entries.
So for me, it’s a great app and it comes highly recommended by me
author: Cliveah

title: Privacy now gone?
content:

The fact that this application has been sold is a real worry for me now. The new privacy policy emphasises the fact that they will be accessing our unique ID for our phones. This of course implies that our data will now be sold to other companies for the purposes of advertising and for Day One to make extra money. Too bad that greed has crept in and has made us nothing more than a commodity.
author: perdox808

title: Love it.
content:

Also I don't want every single entry to show my home address under it! It looks cluttered and unnecessary, I never go anywhere exciting and it's a depressing reminder 😅. I have been going into the metadata and turning off after completing each entry but there must be a better way, if there is, I couldn't find it!

Ok another update edit. I've been wanting to add some links to a couple of entries and it'd be nice if we were able to do that without having the whole long ugly web address in it, which didn't even work anyway! I cannot click the link because it has an apostrophe which seems to kill the link. 

I like the idea of the subscription. The main reason I use this diary app over others is because I can tell this one is in it for the long haul. Nothing worse than having an entire diary become unusable when your OS updates but your app has been abandoned and no longer works with your phone! I am planning to subscribe soon but I am hopeful a few more features will be added! If you can make it so that we can change the font size individually in each entry I’d subscribe on the spot! I don’t know why were given the option in the setting which applies to the entire journal, I NEEEED to be able to add small text occasionally.
author: lisal33

content: I have been using Day One since 2011.  When they said I had to buy it to be able to sync between devices I did. author: SethekS

title: Great until data disappears.
content:
I’ve been a premium user for 11 years and have over 4000 days of entries. I’ve also recommended the app to many people, however I no longer will be. 

I recently had to reinstall the app because it kept crashing and two of my journals  went missing.

I tried all the steps in your help articles to retrieve the missing data, and when that didn’t work I contacted your support, as advised in your help articles.

I was extremely disappointed when your help technicians repeatedly referred me back to the support articles I had already read and suggested methods I had already tried.

It seems the data that went missing has simply disappeared (over 350 entries) and the help technicians can’t explain why or offer an apology.

I trusted your app to store my data, but now doubt the reliability of your service and I’m extremely worried that other journals may go missing in the future when your app crashes again.

No apologies were offered. Just an email stating all options have been exhausted.

At this point I feel like I’m wasting my money on a service that doesn’t actually keep my information safe.

If you value the information you are putting into your entries on the day one app I urge users to seek alternate methods of back up because Day One backups are unreliable as I have sadly discovered.
author: Papa Jules

title: Best App I Have Ever Had

Having a safe and reliable place to journal for years on end, make what this app has given me, more than money can but nor words can explain. A place to save memories, record and remember things, otherwise impossible for the human brain to do alone. It has provided me with joy and security for a long time, and will continue to do so for a long time to come.
author: Housekitten101

title: Fabulous diary app
content: I used to handwrite a diary, especially when travelling. Sadly, I have developed arthritis in my hands and writing is no longer a joy. I’m no longer disappointed - I’ve discovered Day One and I have it on my phone, iPad and MacBook. I mainly use my phone and iPad when on holiday and can record a great diary record almost instantly, including photos. I made a book from a two week road trip last year and am very pleased with the results and the price, considering I live in Australia and it had to travel through Covid-delayed post to get to me from USA. I’ve also found the support to be extremely responsive and helpful. I have the Premium version and consider it well worth it.
author: Mardi5

title: My life in Day One
content: I’ve been using this app for about four years. It has been my source of comfort through some very difficult times when living overseas. It has allowed me to become far more expressive and thoughtful about events that happened in my life. One thing about doing a journal entry is that you’re able to say the things you might not be able to say to another person. This allows you to really take an issue, remove it from your mind, verbalise how you feel and why and give clarity to things you may be confused about. Day One allows you to integrate other parts of your life into this one beautiful app too, such as photographs, that can represent your day and feelings.
author: Sandra E Brown

title: Almost perfect.
content:
I’m so thankful to D1 for having end-to-end zero knowledge encryption. It means all my private notes, photos and videos cannot be read by anyone including D1. I literally moved apps for this feature, it is really a deal maker or breaker, after all… it is your diary! 

Would give this 5/5 stars but the lacking of some basic features really need to be highlighted. It took ages for D1 to implement highlighting! Finally it’s here but you still can’t cross out text or make a basic table, or weird bugs like when you copy a checkbox, the original one disappears… it shouldn’t be like this, D1 please give us the low hanging fruits. 

Thanks for implementing the web version! Literally the last bit feature we could ask for!
author: TypeR21days

title: Book printing
content: I’ve been using this app for many many years and have created many different journals and indeed I’ve also used the facility to print a book from my individual journals and they are very good and compared to other options,  relatively cheap. author: graham3693

title: Life Well Organised
content: I’ve been using the DayOne journalling app for a couple of years now after a break from Evernote and moving away from paper journals. It’s easy for me to organise my ideas, life and business across iPhone and iPad and on my Mac. I have about 6 different journals and use my own custom journal prompt templates. Tagging and finding my journal entries with keyword search works well and I can pick up from where I left off on any of my devices, securely. I love adding handwritten notes, voice notes, drawings and photos when inspiration strikes. I’ve recommended this app to my friends and would recommend it for anyone looking for a secure, portable journal.
author: MelJL1111

title: The original and still the best
content: I’ve been using Day One on my iPhone and Mac for many years now. One of my longest used apps. These guys are the best. Really great devs. Beautifully designed app that I use as my daily journal. They’ve added so many features over the years, lots of which I don’t really use (I just need a simple daily journal) but I’m sure others do and it shows their dedication to the product. Sync is fast and reliable, keeps my journal in sync between iPhone and Mac. They didn’t make my paid apps stop working when they switched to subscription model, which I really appreciate. Bloom Built are the best. Huge fan of these guys.
author: Ddstco

title: AI features make this a 5
content:
I’ve been using day one for 4 years now and it  does everything I needed for the most part, it helps me regulate emotions, remember the special times and reminisce on previous memories,  but the recently released AI features have reduced the friction to journaling so much so that my journaling practices have literally become transformative in my life ! Being able to make quick voice memos through the day and have a fully transcribed journal  entry along with insightful follow up prompts is such an awesome feature and really sets day one even further ahead of it competition. 

Thank you day one team !
author: Christ6326

title: The best investment I’ve ever made for myself.
content: This App is a perfect companion for someone who is interested in growing and appreciate life. I’ve been trying many different journaling Apps over the years (mostly one-time payments.) Honestly, not a single one of them can provide me such a secured and trustworthy service as Day One do. I’ve paid for the whole year subscription. After experiencing it for over three months, I believe I’ll keep supporting this company because it really delivers its promise. Moreover, thanks to the unique options that Day One has. I get to explore different ways to record my life. It’s so much fun to use.
author: avacck

title: Obsessed.
content:
This app goes above-and-beyond. The desktop and mobile apps are both fabulous, and the watch app is incredible!! Love love love audio recordings on watch. 

Day One makes it so easy to create rich memories using all different mediums – words, photos, location, what you’re listening to, stats about your day like the weather and how many steps you’ve done, videos, audio recordings, documents, the list is goes on. I also love all the different font options. Look up “day one markdown guide” for some cool extra ones. ☆

I have made shortcut integrations for planning my day, reflecting on my day, reflecting on my breakup (use the ‘days since’ in shortcuts so you can automatically insert that into your entry, eg. “120 days post-breakup” – nifty.) 

I use templates for things like recording my 5km runs, budget etc. Like I said, this app is just above-and-beyond. 

MORE THAN worth the 10¢ /day I pay for premium. I’d pay many many times that for the value I get from it! ♡ 

Thank-you Day One! ♥
author: ilovetwelve

title: After many years it’s still an effective app
content:
I’ve had dayone for about 4-5 years now and I still find it effective way to journal. The templates and prompts are great. I can have multiple journals, some I can hide. I love making the media journals especially, and that it time stamps the journal with the time and date of the media. 

The only feature I think could make it better would be some more options for exporting the journals in more appealing and engaging formats. 

All things considered, it’s a great app. Thanks for putting it out there

author: Zara234

title: Making a habit out of journaling easy
content: Day one is awesome because you can take it anywhere with you. You always have your phone or other device so your never unable to journal. It has streaks to keep you building the habit. I love that even if you miss a day and you go back the next day you can change the date it was for and therefore not lose your streak. I also love you can design your own templates/questions. Because everyone is different and everyone needs to journal about different moments and experiences.

title: Fantastic e-journal
content:
Absolutely love it and use it almost everyday. I can add up to 10 photos now since they upgraded the version. Continuos improvement has been wonderful. Thank you, creators of DayOne. The one thing I can't do is save photos back to my camera when I want to. Could you enable this function? Tq.

author: TNT.oz

title: BEWARE

author: CrackedChelle33

title: Day one keeps me grounded
content:
Day one has helped me capture my thoughts and allowed me to process a series of things that trouble me during day to day living. It is a fantastic tool to keep you honest with what’s happening around you, especially during these trying times. Whilst I know I won’t always go back to re-read the pages as I use this as a daily journaling exercise, it is always good to know that 5-10 years down the line, I have a place to revisit my thoughts again, if needed. 

Highly recommend!
author: CB2019w

title: Looks different than on the AppStore

content: No. I didn’t get a prompt to rate DayOne. I took the time to write a review.  Just an incredible app. Love everthing about it. Very thoughtful design. Bit Applesque like Steve Jobs. author: Koolace

title: Best journaling app
content:
Very easy to get into the habit of writing everyday. The photos make it dynamic and all the metadata such as location, time and weather that gets added automatically makes for a unique experience you can’t get with a regular paper app. 

I love being able to export the journal at the end of the year and keep on my book shelf. The new look books are really cool with maps for each month. Highly recommended.
author: FilminDylan

title: Been using this app since 2017
content: I love this app! I love how discreet it is, I love the layout and I use it frequently. I don’t even feel the need to own a physical journal because of this app. However this morning when I tried getting into it, it would let me in? I guess it was updating? So I reset my phone and now I can’t get in at all!! I don’t want to lose what I have in there. Is this a bug? Please fix it! Anyway keep up the good work, but let me back in! :(
author: Imy141

title: Perfect journal!
content: I have been using this app for nearly a week and I’m so happy with the flexibility that it offers. I have full control over what I want to cover every day and how many times a day. Thanks to this app, I can check in with my thoughts, feelings and actions 3 times a day without having to get out a physical diary in front of everyone at work. Thank you for making this!
author: Anastasia_-Gar123

title: I have given up the paper diary, which took too much space and storage!
content: As much as it pained me to to the change, I now have all my entries in one place, searchable and environment friendly. We have a small house and the 30+ journals were really stacking up. I’ve used this app for at least a year now (possibly more, I could check but I couldn’t be bothered!!) and I absolutely love it!
author: canwillbh

title: Great for the memories
content: I love this app. I bought it several years ago and didn’t quite get into it as I should as I was always posting on social media. Now that I am using social media less I love how I can look back and see what I’ve been up to. My friends and family also appreciate when I share on this day with them to show that I’m thinking of them. Thanks DayOne team.
author: SueH18

title: Great app
content: I can’t remember what I paid for my subscription but whatever it is, it’s worth it. They really do offer personalised support and 5e app works seamlessly. I haven’t tried their printing service for journals so can’t comment about that, but I save my journals as PDF anyway, so can always print later if I want. I use this app on iPad and MacBook Air and have no problems syncing. Easy to add photos and other info to journals which is very useful.
author: Girl1966

title: Love this App.
content: This app allows me track and record my every movement, adding as many photos as I wish, mapping my location and multiple diaries each for different purposes. It’s a great way to record and sort your business life and personal adventures throughout the year. Looking back on your achievements or adventures is easy and enjoyable. I highly recommend this app for both business and pleasure recording.
author: Tropic Fox

title: Good app just needs a couple of extra functions
content:
This is a good app for keeping all your notes in specific journal categories. If it could also use the apple pen (not just for drawing) and attach documents to notes it would be super fab for work. Be great if it connected to LinkedIn so you could send articles for my reading list journal. 

When I changed text colour it changed the entire paragraph - I only wanted one sentence. 

Otherwise, it’s probably one of the best note taking apps.
author: leigh435

title: Amazing app
content:
We use day one for homeschooling 
As we can keep brilliant records of all homeschool days and events .. things achieved, photos of things made, events undertaken etc etc and all presented in great format that is all in timeline, so when we have to present a years work the 1st thing we do is show them day one for our 2 boys.
Wonderful homeschool tool wonderful app…..also great service
author: mattvicks2

title: Loved Since Day One
content: I have used this application for what feels like a decade now. I have loved every second of it, from a moody teenager laying down my thoughts, to capturing ideas, university notes and more. It’s something you don’t notice because it just works. Two top features I love is one, Markdown, two encryption. If I could suggest just one feature it would be to regenerative a new key.
author: Matthew.Media

title: Support Worker
content:
I have been using this app for 3 years now. This is one of the best tools I have for writing my notes for my participants. 
Why: because I can have multiple participants per day and the app allows me too. 
There has been times I needed to show my boss a situation that occurred months before. I just went through my notes and there is was stored. Perfect app. 

Maria
author: Smileymum72

title: GAME CHANGER
content: Literally changed my life… Using the template function to prompt me to take action for myself, check off daily reminders and checklists, I have been able to find happiness and success in ways that I didn’t know possible. This app is the convergence point for all your of self improvement strategies and can be the catalyst for some serious change.
author: i808i

title: The BEST journaling app
content: I have used Day One on a daily basis for over 11 years. During that time I have never discovered anything that came anywhere near close to Day One. As a creative it enables me to add different kinds of media, which I value and appreciate. I’m a committed Day One user and recommend it often to friends and anyone who will listen. 10/10 for Day One from me!
author: Old rock star

title: Helping hand
content: Only had this app for 2 months. It’s very helpful to keep track of how things are going or not going. Sometimes I don’t want to or feel like posting but I force myself and make note of it. Really is a smart app, helpful in many ways, .. me iam not used to journaling , but this is baby steps for me to really make an effort, thank you for making the app... one of my more favourite practical apps. Cheers Zach
author: Zacho78

title: Best Journal App
content: I would go as far as to say this is the best journaling app. I’ve tried a lot and I would say the features and the sleek UI of DayOne stands out from others. I don’t even use Premium but am considering buying it as has its genuine perks for a reasonable price. Been using this app since 2023 and never had an issue with it. One of the better apps on my phone.
author: GauthamNair

title: The best at jotting down the ideas I have
content:
This has helped me solve my everyday problems and ideas I have in my head as well as plan events and uppocming deadlines that I have to meet. I would recommend this to a college student, employee or even someone just wanting to think things through but doesnt have a clear direction. 

Thanks heaps guys!
author: Hgmyrhgr

title: Easy and captures my thoughts
content: It is a very good app that I can write about things on the day or back date from my photos date. It indicates that photos I have had used or not been used for my journal. Anytime when I feel free to write something or take a picture of that rememberable moment, the ‘journal book’ is on my hands.
author: iPad 2 user 9999

title: LOVE AND OBSESSED
content: I’ve LOOKED for years to find a good journal and I couldn’t say anything wrong about this APP. Designed so well. Thank you so much for helping me write down my life. Worth every $$. I know this might sound silly but having a good journal to write in has kept me consistent and has changed my life. Thank you to the creators. You must have a big heart to help others find there way through journaling xo
author: Suzgrace

title: Worth the upgrade.
content:
I purchased the original Day One and this one has gone leaps and bounds ahead in order to make the user interface intuitive and user friendly.  Especially for the time poor, and or lazy journal writers...

The simple interface offers review of the activities of the day, including location info and photos incorporated into the one place...  a dream and oh so simple to use...

This iPad version is worth the value add on if you’re syncing with your Mac version...  

This App is kind of becoming a time machine backup for my brain and the endless amount of stuff it holds...   calendar view allows simple access to all entries and tags keep it relevant...

A “Get Stuff Done” companion and champion App.
author: JimmyOz

title: Very sharp
content:
Day One is a journaling app that I have really enjoyed using. It's simple to use, yet has a variety of features that make it a powerful tool for journaling.

One of the things I like most with Day One is that it allows me to add photos, videos, and audio recordings to your entries. This is a great way to capture my memories in a more complete way.
author: The Judgetribe

title: Best app for Journaling
content:
I have been a consistent user nearly 5 years. At first I was hesitant committing to a journal as they might go down and lose all my data. But I decided to use it because of the easy of use. 

I also signed up as a premium user to support the app. It’s so worth it. i’m totally loving this app. Happy to keep my premium subscription. 👍
author: lorodz

title: Sensational App
content: Gorgeous and intuitive, Day One is everything you would hope for in a journaling app and the the development team has truly gone above and beyond in what it can offer.  I highly recommend journelling through this form to anyone who wishes to preserve their thoughts and experiences whether as a form of catharsis or to form a greater awareness of yourself.
author: iHannahHeart

title: Simple, yet amazing
content: Got recommended this app to help with clearing my mind before bed. I love it; I love the templates; I love the simplicity of it; I love that it’s simple to use. My favourite part is the daily prompts as it’s something different every single day and it helps me think and reflect in an overall sense. I’m not a big journal writer, but the templates are good and concise yet still in depth
author: Ronan K 98

title: Been such a blessing!
content: When I broke my arm, I couldn’t type and day one has a voice button, so I could speak into my journal. It was a life-saver for me. A great app. I have about 20 journals going now and it amazes me how many memories I make. I love that you can turn them into a book if you want later on. Yeah I highly recommend it.
author: kMORIAHu

title: Love the daily prompts.
content: Simple and straightforward to use. The daily prompts are really useful and inspiring, makes me reflect on things that I otherwise would not. It is really helpful to be able to put pictures and text together to form a more detailed memory. Its all private keeping these thoughts and occurrences all to yourself.
author: bigbearbrownie

title: I love day one
content: However, I am having a problem getting my iPhone 12 to update all my entries from my iPhone 14…. That seems to be a glitch for which I have not been able to discover a solution … I am hoping the day one folks will read this review and send me some effective solution suggestions 😊
author: A1b3c

title: Simple, easy to use
content: I wanted a basic journal app, and this fills the bill. I wish there were a HELP function so I can learn how to edit some of the built-in options. I can’t locate introductory instructions (the fact that I can’t find them doesn’t mean they aren’t there). If you’re slightly more tech-adept than I am, you probably won’t have any problems with Day One.
author: Dorothy in Oz

title: My favourite App
content: Thank you for creating a user-friendly and logical application, where I can easily store and capture the everyday sections and chapters of my life. I have used this for almost 3 years, daily. I would love to be able to use the app on my PC as well. Look forward to that update when it occurs.
author: South_Tank

title: Disappointed
content:
I used to use this app way back when it didn’t require a subscription fee just to sync a backup to iCloud—iCloud storage that I’m paying to have. 

So sick of all these greedy subscription apps. How many different subscriptions do you think people can afford to pay? Half the apps I download nowadays want a subscription and now even a diary app wants it? I could go buy a basic book from the store and write it in and it’ll only cost me the one fee. 

Disappointed that you went subscription like so many others. Deleted and won’t be using again.
author: queenjodos3

title: I love this app (mostly!)
content:
I've been using Day One for some years now and I love it's features and the way it prompts me to keep going. 
One thing I wish it could do is allow me to create entries in handwriting with my Apple pencil and not convert it to text. There's something so much more personal about reading my own handwriting.
author: evernow

title: Practical Journal
content: This is a very useful resource. It is intuitive and even the basic account allows for enough info to make sense of complex matters. It would be great though if the basic account would allow two images instead of just one. All in all, very happy I downloaded the App.
author: CharlieIbis

title: Best Digital Journal App
content: I’ve tried heaps of journalling apps and this is the only one I’ve been able to stay consistent with for YEARS! I absolutely love being able to see this time last year memories and switch to the calendar view. With the page templates, daily prompts and streaks - I highly recommend Day One!!
author: Kiza808

title: Family Memory
content:
I have been using Day One for nearly 6 years. What an amazing time capsule for my son.

I print a bound book every 6 months. The whole family agrees that if there was a fire in the house, these books would be the first thing that we would grab as we ran out the door.
author: switchedoffhalfway

title: Love this app
content:
I’m trying to lose weight and this app has helped me keep track of all my food. I love the tags option. I can assign tags to the type of day I’ve had and then clearly see how many days in the week I’ve been good or messed up. 

I know this app is primarily for journal writing but it’s been very helpful with my food tracking as well.
author: vmassturn

title: Love it
content:
User friendly, great features.

I’d love it if there was the option for links and photos (or entries in general)  to display similarly to the timeline and image/link previews in Facebook. Would make it a more enjoyable experience to scroll through entries at a glance, or to find something specific.

Great app, thank you :)
author: NellHarro

title: Life changing as a process (not the app)
content: You can have all the skills and positivity in the world, but if you don’t take time out to reflect, you are robbing yourself of insights which are waiting for you. author: iloveapps99

title: Essential
content:
LOVE This app. Super quick and easy to use. 
BUT PLEASE what’s this paid subscription about?  It was a good value app when I bought it for $10 a few years ago.  I paid for it and I should be able to use it without paying any more.  I’m quite unimpressed that now in 2018 you want to charge me an ongoing $ subscription for using it.  That’s scammy.
author: Akkun's Mama

author: MateyCool

title: Journal on the go
content: I’m new to to Day one and I’m really enjoying the portable journal aspect of it. No longer to I need to write notes to write down in my journal at the end of the day. author: Annoyeeeddddd

title: Day-One-Review
content:
Day one is a fantastic app to use, you can write down all your thoughts even private ones because you can even set a lock on the app so other people cannot get in.

I use it all the time because I know so can write whatever I want down there in a private place.
author: papper planes

title: User Friendly
content: Great app with user friendly interface. The fact it can run across multiple devices means I can journal at any time.  It has a time stamp for each journal makes it easy to work out at what time o f the day I wrote it.  I can also back date all my all old  journal entries.
author: Conna.77

title: The best journaling application

author: nate_boy2133

title: Fantastic app
content: I’ve had this app for many years now. I purchased it outright and every time I get a new phone there’s no hassle reinstating my purchase and all my files are there. It’s solid as and a great journaling app. I only wish there was the ability to hand write your entries with the Apple Pencil.
author: Karina1122

title: Stand out app!
content:
Went through so many of these sorts of apps not even knowing exactly what I wanted.

Pathologically inept at organising and remembering my life and this app has brought me relief, joy(what a cr*p word) and gratitude. 

Intuitive, customisable, as others have said, you have a lot of freedom without having to learn anything difficultz
author: smashscat

title: Every day and makes me feel good

Nearly 1000days. Doesn’t have to be long and makes me feel good, whether I dictate on the same day the next day or a week later.

author: Vinceontheroad

Mirrors the notes app closely would love to see it be as free flowing as notes for handwriting. 

Otherwise no complaints!
author: Dump85

title: Great App.
content:
This is one of those necessary apps that helps to keep track of daily appointments and notes that I am very likely to forget. I would be totally lost without this help.

author: Mitsy2015

author: Sugarbelle1234

title: BRILLIANT

author: Baby Thanos

title: Awesome app

author: mfschmidtkamp

author: Karolyng

Addendum to original review: the app used to be totally perfect but they’re adding unnecessary flourishes to the design and it makes me cringe.

author: aiajt2

author: HanzTapz

title: High hopes .... Fulfilled eventually.
content:
'Classic' Day One has been my companion on trips, holidays and just everyday life for over five years now. It's been there, reliably, when I had something to note. 
The 'new, improved' 2.0 imported my old entries... then crashed whenever I tried to review more than two or three entries. I was very, very sad because there were some new features I really wanted to use.

I could go on but I'll stop - birthday duties call. I'll just say, for the money it's the best app I ever bought.

title: Not here for it
content:
I've been using this app daily since 2013. I happily transitioned from version 1 to version 2. This app has been invaluable for me, keeping track of memories and milestones. My progress through rough patches and my ups and downs. I occasionally look through my older entries, and to see how life has progressed captures an emotion that can't be explained.

Whilst version 2 made some questionable UI and UX decisions, overall the additions and enhancements (and constant iteration) made the quirks manageable. I was a content user. I was confident that my extremely personal data would be kept safe and secure, especially with end-to-end encryption (let's just say, I'd much rather someone get my credit card details than my Day One entries...)

Now, you've gone ahead and slapped an ugly $54 annual subscription onto this beautiful little app.

Okay, so I'm genuinely curious: what made you think people would be happy to spend $4.49 A MONTH on an app that cost that much, one-time, up-front, a week ago?

To add insult to injury, you've put us non-subscription ("Plus") users on 'maintenance mode': all we're going to get are 'bug fixes'. No new features. No feature requests.

I don't want to see this app fail. It's become a part of my memory and recollection process. Maybe you'll have to hit rock bottom to see just how good things were.

Sadly, I don't see you reversing this ill-advised decision, evidently made in the insular bubble of the tech blogosphere which applauds this short-sighted business model.

Nothing I can say or do will affect this decision (or a reversal of it). Just know you've severely, personally disappointed someone.

title: High hopes .... Fulfilled eventually.

title: Not here for it
content:
I've been using this app daily since 2013. I happily transitioned from version 1 to version 2. This app has been invaluable for me, keeping track of memories and milestones. My progress through rough patches and my ups and downs. I occasionally look through my older entries, and to see how life has progressed captures an emotion that can't be explained.

Whilst version 2 made some questionable UI and UX decisions, overall the additions and enhancements (and constant iteration) made the quirks manageable. I was a content user. I was confident that my extremely personal data would be kept safe and secure, especially with end-to-end encryption (let's just say, I'd much rather someone get my credit card details than my Day One entries...)

Now, you've gone ahead and slapped an ugly $54 annual subscription onto this beautiful little app.

Okay, so I'm genuinely curious: what made you think people would be happy to spend $4.49 A MONTH on an app that cost that much, one-time, up-front, a week ago?

To add insult to injury, you've put us non-subscription ("Plus") users on 'maintenance mode': all we're going to get are 'bug fixes'. No new features. No feature requests.

I don't want to see this app fail. It's become a part of my memory and recollection process. Maybe you'll have to hit rock bottom to see just how good things were.

Sadly, I don't see you reversing this ill-advised decision, evidently made in the insular bubble of the tech blogosphere which applauds this short-sighted business model.

Nothing I can say or do will affect this decision (or a reversal of it). Just know you've severely, personally disappointed someone.
